# AI Chatbot Development

Fixture Corp builds retrieval-augmented chatbots that answer questions from a customer's own documents.
Typical deployments include internal HR policy assistants, customer support bots and website concierge agents.

## Deployment options

Chatbots can run on the customer's own servers with local language models, or connect to a hosted model API.
Fixture Corp integrates chatbots with existing websites, intranets and messaging channels.

## Engagement process

Every chatbot project starts with a discovery workshop to understand the documents and users involved.
After discovery the team delivers a prototype, collects feedback and then moves to a production rollout.
